title.en: Control of Rent (Exemption — Statutory Bodies) (Consolidation) Notification

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Control of Rent (Exemption — Statutory Bodies) (Consolidation) Notification.

2. The following properties and premises are exempted from the provisions of the Act:
(a)all premises belonging to, leased or rented by the Port of Singapore Authority;
[S 310/51]
[10.8.51]
(b)all properties of the National University of Singapore;
[S 186/70]
[10.7.70]
(c)all premises belonging to, leased or rented by the Singapore Tourist Promotion Board;
[S 258/70]
[18.9.70]
(d)all properties of the Telecommunications Authority of Singapore;
[S 78/71]
[12.3.71]
(e)all properties of the Sentosa Development Corporation situate in Sentosa; and
[S 240/73]
[20.7.73]
(f)all properties belonging to, leased or sold by the Urban Redevelopment Authority.
[S 52/79]
[9.3.79]
